node: AI photonics inputs: InP substrates, continuous-wave lasers, external light sources, and silicon-photonics materials
summary: Layer 1B expands the underfollowed public-asset universe around upstream AI photonics inputs rather than obvious AI compute leaders. The strongest direct candidate is AXTI for InP and compound-semiconductor substrates; POET is a plausible second-order optical-integration and light-source platform candidate; Sivers/SIVEF is a high-purity but more speculative OTC-accessible candidate for CW DFB laser arrays and external light sources. These are research candidates only, not recommendations. Key gating evidence for later layers: customer qualification, volume orders, export-control impact, manufacturing yield, partner dependence, and whether CPO/optical-I/O adoption translates into revenue rather than prototype interest.
